name: duel_breach
description: 0.9.0's sends that bite (release page, Undertow): a duel on Undertow's own rules, me a Lamplighter defending with her plan, a caretaker Lamplighter the rival. In window 2 I cork the Moth Cloud (fliers, which the Lamplighter is weak to) with a click on the Drift tray, say Ready, and uncork it with Space once I may; nothing else is staged. My four Duskmoths fly the rival's road among its own wave 2; the camera on the rival's hollow (V), the moment the first of them reaches its Holdfast: 'Breach · +N gold', the duel bar counting my breach.
